hook: THE *EMI IS DUE. THE ACCOUNT IS *NOT ENOUGH.
title: F21 · emi · The Fifth of the Month
lines: The EMI is twenty-three thousand. The balance is nine.
He has done the sum four times. It comes out the same.
School fees next week. His mother's medicines. The shop rent.
In the morning he will tell them all that everything is fine.
He looked up at the shelf. The little lingam. The throat of the god in the picture above it, dark blue.
He had always thought it was just the colour.
He did not swallow the poison. He did not spit it on anyone. He held it.
and for the first time, showed her the ledger.
Carry it. But you were never meant to carry it alone. That is sadhana.
